author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read MikroTik RouterOS login lines and firewall rule log lines, sent by a remote logging action as syslog to the data collector. Login lines go to Auth and firewall rule log lines to Netflow; every other RouterOS line is left to the parsers already in the tenant.
notes:
Setup:
- Set the remote logging action to remote-log-format=syslog, add-topics-string=yes and syslog-time-format=iso8601, and add rules for the info, error and critical topics (the firewall lines use info, login failures error and critical).
- The firewall line doesn't say what the rule did, so put ACCEPT, ALLOW, DROP, REJECT, BLOCK or DENY in the rule's log-prefix to fill flow_action.

Field mapping:
- Login lines go to Auth and firewall rule log lines (action=log or log=yes) to Netflow; every other RouterOS line is left to the parsers already in the tenant.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the formats the RouterOS manual describes.

Testing:
- Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13, and the parent's confirm string picked the same lines there.
- On 2026-10-14 each child also passed Run Test in a lab tenant as a separate parser under its parent.

Known gaps:
- The CEF format isn't covered.
